findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: x402_recommend, x402_precheck, x402_verify_settlement, solana_mint_check, web_read_markdown, email_check · Private data: x402_recommend, x402_precheck, x402_verify_settlement, solana_mint_check, web_read_markdown, email_check · Public sink: email_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: x402_recommend, x402_precheck, x402_verify_settlement, solana_mint_check, web_read_markdown, email_check · Private data: x402_recommend, x402_precheck, x402_verify_settlement, solana_mint_check, web_read_markdown, email_check · Public sink: email_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
